subject: POC/Trial planning - RACI & stakeholder mapping (Verdant Health)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@verdanthealth.org>, Tom Phillips <tom.phillips@verdanthealth.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC/Trial planning - initial recap & proposed success criteria

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed next steps list so we can align on ownership and timelines before we kick off the trial.

Call recap (high level)
- Goal: Run a 2-week POC to validate Redwood inference runtime for generating clinical note summaries and embeddings for search across ~1M patient notes.
- Scale target: 50 concurrent users, 20 qps sustained, average request size ~1k tokens.
- Data: de-identified subset (10k notes) for initial eval; production will use VPC/private deployment.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm)
1) Latency: 95th percentile < 300ms for 1k-token requests in the trial environment.
2) Cost: projected per-token inference cost <= $0.0009 with suggested batching/quantization profile.
3) Quality: human eval — >=85% on annotation pass rate for summary fidelity across random 200 sample set.
4) Reliability: no more than 1% error/retry rate over the trial window.

POC plan (draft)
- Duration: 2 weeks (sandbox), followed by optional 4-week production verification.
- Redwood responsibilities: runtime config, model selection, quickstart onboarding, daily health check-ins.
- Verdant responsibilities: provide de-identified dataset, test user accounts, infra access (VPN/VPC peering) if needed, and procurement/PO for dedicated capacity.

Key asks from Verdant to confirm before we schedule kickoff:
- Who owns infra/network (IT Ops) vs app/product vs security vs procurement? Please list names and the procurement timeline.
- Any specific compliance items required for the sandbox (additional questionnaires, logging)?
- Are the success criteria above acceptable, or should we tweak thresholds?

Attached: Verdant_POC_Scope_v1.pdf (scope + technical checklist).

Proposed next step: 30–45 minute kickoff & alignment meeting next Tue/Wed. I can send a calendar invite once we confirm attendees.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0199

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the clear recap and the doc. High level: the plan looks good. A few notes and stakeholder details below.

Stakeholders (Verdant)
- Product / App owner (Accountable): Sara Kim — I will own overall acceptance criteria and sign-off on summaries.
- IT / Infra (Responsible): Tom Phillips (IT Ops) — will handle VPN/VPC peering and test environment provisioning.
- Security (Consulted): Lena Ortiz (InfoSec) — will review logging and data handling; may have a short questionnaire.
- Procurement / Legal (Responsible for PO/contract): procurement@verdanthealth.org (Procurement Lead: Monica Patel).

Procurement timeline
- Procurement will review scope and send back an initial PO/terms draft week of Nov 9. They typically require a short SOW + PO template; I am copying procurement so they have visibility.

Comments on success criteria
- Latency target: 300ms 95p is aggressive but acceptable for the sandbox if we use the recommended batching and quantization settings.
- Quality metric: we will use a clinical QA panel (3 clinicians) to annotate the 200-sample set; 85% pass rate is reasonable.

Next steps from our side
- Tom will confirm infra availability and any network windows by Nov 5.
- Procurement will reach out to finalize PO template the week of Nov 9.

Thanks — please include Lena if InfoSec needs to sign anything.

—Sara
